head: d641ec1fc39b8e6cc6383ce2ecdd91dc1adc2f16
claim: A consumer app installs the packed @byokit/accounts built with the bumped provider SDK pins, links a ChatGPT account against the loopback stand-in and gets a streamed answer

steps.start: a fresh consumer app with no package installed and no account linked
steps: install the shipped @byokit/accounts package into the app
the app links a ChatGPT account by device code: it shows a code and the person approves it
the app reads the account status
the app asks the provider a question and prints the answer it gets back
steps.result: the installed package answers: "ChatGPT is connected." and the answer "You said: Plan my day"

verdicts.seen: I read all 7 entries: package line, sign-in code, status 'ChatGPT is connected.', streamed and answer lines both 'You said: Plan my day', plus the 'not offered' and 'no account' lines. The header confirms the tgz install from npm pack, the loopback stand-in provider, and 'run: node consumer.mjs (exit 0)'. The two error lines are negative-case checks and do not contradict the outcome. The outcome names one part, so parts and covers are empty. The bumped provider SDK pins are not visible in this capture, but the outcome's core claim is shown.
